title: App Usage Breakdown
dataSources: RescueTime activity (`rescuetime:activity`), screen-time exports (`screentime:usage`), GitHub events (`github:personal`), habit-tracker logs (`habit:entry`), calendar exports.
app: Screen-time / RescueTime exports, GitHub personal activity, habit/journal trackers, and calendar feeds via HEC scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=screentime:usage
| bin _time span=1w
| stats sum(minutes) as minutes by app _time
| stats avg(minutes) as avg_weekly_min by app
| eval avg_weekly_h=round(avg_weekly_min/60,1)
| sort - avg_weekly_h
| head 15
description: Ranks which apps eat the most of your time each week, naming the specific culprits behind your screen-time total.
value: A total is abstract; naming the exact apps stealing your hours is what actually prompts you to delete or limit one.
implementation: Export per-app usage; schedule weekly and review the biggest time sinks.
visualization: Bar chart of average weekly hours by app.
grandmaExplanation: It shows exactly which apps take up most of your time, so you know which one to cut back on.
